name: Niimi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Niimi city emblem in green: a shield-like device of three curved segments.
history: Municipal flag of Niimi, a city in Okayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 30 June 2005.

features.role: Niimi city emblem — a shield-like device of three curved segments
